research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Forever Labs is engaged in research and development focused on the isolation of biological materials, as indicated by the title Device and Method of Isolating Extracellular Vesicles. The abstract describes a centrifugal device with a container and cap designed to receive or transmit air or other substances, facilitating the separation and collection of extracellular vesicles. This work highlights their efforts in developing technologies for isolating cellular components relevant to stem cell banking.
